SCENES.living: Night inside an ordinary lived-in Chinese apartment living room. Fixed layout: faded teal two-seat sofa against back wall left; low rectangular scratched brown coffee table in middle; tall window with pale grey curtains on right wall; closed dark green entry door far left; small open kitchen behind left doorway. One warm shaded lamp beside sofa, cold blue night through window. Water ring on table, chipped table edge, scuffed skirting, stacked dinner bowls and two small drinking glasses. Pale grey thermos with navy cap and one wordless mountain sticker is upright at table right edge. No people, no phones, no text.
SCENES.window: Same apartment right wall tall window, grey curtains partly open, viewed from inside beside sofa. Outside below: small old neighborhood gatehouse with flat green roof, orange parcel lockers beside gate, parked dark cars across street. Scuffed sill, peeling paint, slippers on floor, cold night light, single warm table lamp behind. No people, no lurking silhouettes, no text.
SCENES.door: Same apartment closed dark green entry door, cream walls with water stains and chipped skirting, small shoe rack and grey slippers, edge of dining table in foreground. Night, one warm practical light and cool window spill. Door closed and locked. No people, no numbers or text.
